sonnet.problem: The story card says the Philistine garrison is at Bethlehem right before card 10 asks where the well is. Bethlehem is the only town the baker has been given, so the setup points to the right answer and makes the other two answers (Hebron, Jericho) look unlikely.
sonnet.rule: No card ever gives away the answer to a choice card that comes later. ... A setup line can't rule out the wrong answers either.
